'''Kathryn Leonard''' is an American mathematician and computer scientist. She was President of the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] and is now AWM Past-President.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Executive Committee |url=https://awm-math.org/about/executive-committee/ |access-date=2023-03-29 |website=Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM) |language=en-US}}</ref> She is also director of the NSF-funded [[Center for Undergraduate Research in Mathematics]]. She is currently on the [[American Mathematical Society]] Nominating Committee.<ref>{{Cite web |title=AMS Committees |url=http://www.ams.org/about-us/governance/committees/comm-all.html |access-date=2023-03-29 |website=American Mathematical Society |language=en}}</ref>

Leonard's research focuses on geometric modeling with applications to computer vision, computer graphics, and data science. She has received multiple major grants, including a [[National Science Foundation CAREER Awards|National Science Foundation CAREER Award]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Faculty Profiles: Kathryn Leonard |url=http://ciapps.csuci.edu/FacultyBiographies/kathryn.leonard |website=CSU Channel Islands |accessdate=7 April 2019 |archive-date=7 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190407163644/http://ciapps.csuci.edu/FacultyBiographies/kathryn.leonard |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Leonard and [[Misha Collins]], together with several other collaborators, are authors of "The 2D shape structure dataset", an article on a crowd-sourced database on the structure of shapes.<ref>{{cite journal |title=The 2D shape structure dataset: A user annotated open access database |journal=Computers & Graphics |date=August 2016 |volume=58 |pages=23–30 |doi=10.1016/j.cag.2016.05.009 |last1=Carlier |first1=Axel |last2=Leonard |first2=Kathryn |last3=Hahmann |first3=Stefanie |last4=Morin |first4=Geraldine |last5=Collins |first5=Misha |doi-access=free }}</ref>

==Recognition==
Leonard received a [[Henry L. Alder Award]] from the [[Mathematical Association of America]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web |title=Henry L. Alder Award |url=https://www.maa.org/programs-and-communities/member-communities/maa-awards/teaching-awards/henry-l-alder-award |website=Mathematical Association of America |accessdate=7 April 2019 |archive-date=14 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210214005624/https://www.maa.org/programs-and-communities/member-communities/maa-awards/teaching-awards/henry-l-alder-award |url-status=dead }}</ref> She received the AWM Service Award from the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] (AWM) in 2015.<ref>{{cite web |title=Association for Women in Mathematics Service Award 2015 |url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-service-award/awm-service-award-2015/ |website=Association for Women in Mathematics |accessdate=7 April 2019}}</ref> The Association for Women in Mathematics named her to their 2025 Class of AWM Fellows.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://awm-math.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/AWM-News-Nov-Dec-2024-WEB.pdf|magazine=AWM News|date=November–December 2025|title=The AWM Fellows Program|page=8|volume=54|issue=6}}</ref>
